# R5.14b — Required-grade pending: consumer wiring (leg b of the `07b6be09` SPLIT)

**Summary.** Wires every declared scored consumer to the one admitted
`hh-experiment::disposition::plan_disposition_at` owner contract landed
by R5.14 leg (a) — **consumed unchanged; no divergent per-consumer
predicate** (X7). Ticket `docs/tickets/183a_R5.14b__pending-consumers.md`
(seq 183a). Scoped review verdict **AMEND** on the ≤900 trigger
(record `planning/2026-11-02_R5.14b2-split-review.md`, ruling `d4aba7ad`).

## What changed

- `hh-results` — `ScoringContext.experiment_run: Option<OverlayRef>`:
  the admission pin; `project_row` folds the experiment view at the pin,
  locates the binding plan, composes `plan_disposition_at` — a pending
  read withholds `outcome_class` and stamps
  `outcome.disposition = "pending"` (pending is an admission state,
  never an outcome class); graded/oracle_failure restore the class; the
  experiment pin enters `watermark_set`. `Field::Disposition` declared
  query field. `ResultsError::DispositionUnresolved` typed refusal
  (absent resolver / no binding plan / owner read refused — never a
  silent legacy downgrade). `export_rows` — pending +
  `foreign_leaderboard_submission` → `LeaderboardRefused`; lowered
  targets list `outcome.disposition` `no_slot` (T-LCD-11).
- `hh-eval` — `EvalRun.disposition: Option<String>` caller-set
  records-in member (no new dependency edge);
  `compare::in_denominator` — `disposition:"pending"` enters no
  denominator whatever `outcome_class` the record claims.
- `hh-analysis` — `eval_run` propagates `row.outcome.disposition` onto
  the eval record (agreement plumbing for the compare gate).
- `hh-embed` — `lab_analysis_analyze` refuses `grade_pending` over any
  selected row with `outcome.disposition == "pending"` (typed
  `Refused`, never a silent exclusion).
- Batteries `tests/r5_14b.rs` in all three crates + literal-construction
  fallout (`OutcomeSection{`/`EvalRun{`/`ScoringContext{` sites gain
  `disposition`/`experiment_run` members).

## Acceptance criteria

- **AC-1 (positive D/E) — MET:** every declared consumer composes the
  same `plan_disposition_at` — results withhold/export legs, eval
  compare gate, embed analysis refusal; step-6 agreement proven
  (`graded_disposition_agrees_with_owner_and_scheduler`: owner read,
  scheduler `pending_plans` fold, row, export agree);
  `old_watermark_reproduces_the_earlier_selection` — a report pinned
  pre-revision reproduces the earlier selection byte-identically

- **AC-2 (negative D/E) — MET:** each consumer independently refuses
  scored success/completion while pending (query `outcome_class`
  cannot match / `disposition` selects; `LeaderboardRefused`;
  pending never denominates even carrying `outcome_class=scored` +
  value; `Refused{grade_pending}` at the analysis boundary). Legacy
  preservation: `legacy_absent_freeze_is_byte_identical` — no freeze →
  no `disposition` member, identical outcome; a pin under a legacy
  binding resolves `mode:"legacy"` unchanged.
- **AC-3 (ownership/evidence) — MET:** REQ-E-202/REQ-E-008 discharged

  REQ-E-102/103/201/204 stamped contributing-only (+R5.14b); dated
  discharge note keeps achieved D/E separate from owed R/P/actual-

- **AC-4 (scoped verification) — MET with recorded deviation:** fmt
  clean; batteries 7/3/2 green; owning-package suites all-ok;

- **AC-5 (universal gate) — MET:** guard PASS DISPATCH R5.14b
